run_shortcut_free_evaluation: run shortcut-free evaluation of latent multi-hop reasoning on a model using the SOCRATES dataset
run_completion_vllm: run model completions on a dataset using vLLM backend with tensor parallel and GPU memory control
run_completion_hf: run model completions on a dataset using HuggingFace Transformers backend with batched inference
read_evaluation_dataframe: read a CSV evaluation dataset into a pandas DataFrame with automatic column type conversion
get_shortcut_free_metrics: get shortcut-free evaluation metrics from a DataFrame containing model completions
